text_block_list.text:
On my way back from an errand I was
given by
Директор Акикава, Winning
Ticket stops me.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hey! Trainer over there! You seen a
white snake
around?
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Another empty lead? White snake,
where could
you be?!
text_block_list.name: Свип Тошо
choice_data_list: Why are you looking for a white snake anyway?

text_block_list.text:
I need one for a good luck charm! It's a
super
high-level spell!
text_block_list.name: Свип Тошо

text_block_list.text: WAIT, SERIOUSLY?!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит
choice_data_list: You didn't tell her the details?

text_block_list.text:
She ran off before I had the chance to!
And we
didn't even have any clues to go
on!
text_block_list.name: Свип Тошо

text_block_list.text: Sigh... I bet Granny'd use her magic and find it straight away.
text_block_list.name: Свип Тошо
choice_data_list: She sounds like an incredible woman.

text_block_list.text:
She is! That's why I wanna be a great
witch like
her one day!
text_block_list.name: Свип Тошо

text_block_list.text:
In that case, let's go ask your granny to
help us
out!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Nooo way! This is something I have to
handle
myself!
text_block_list.name: Свип Тошо

text_block_list.text: ...I'll never be like Granny if I don't!
text_block_list.name: Свип Тошо

text_block_list.text: I will find that white snake, and I will use it for the ritual! And then I'll become a real witch!
text_block_list.name: Свип Тошо

text_block_list.text: AWWW YEEEAAAH!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
You're really trying to make your dream
come
true! That fighting spirit makes me
feel sooo...
FIRED UP! Wooo! Thanks for
the boost!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna help you out! One way or
another, we'll
find that white snake!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Heh! Then the search is back on! You
help too!
text_block_list.name: Свип Тошо

text_block_list.text:
And so I find myself roped into a snake
hunt... We
comb the fields together but
come up
empty-handed.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: That's it! I'm tired of walking! I wanna go hooooome!
text_block_list.name: Свип Тошо

text_block_list.text: We can't quit now! Let's search the town!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: There's no way it'll be here!
text_block_list.name: Свип Тошо

text_block_list.text:
We have to try, no matter how slim our
chances!
Come on, we're just getting
warmed up here,
guys!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna give you all I got, Sweep! If
you feel
like dropping out, I'm gonna
pick you right back
up! That's what I'm
here to do!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Hmph! Who said I'm giving up?!
text_block_list.name: Свип Тошо

text_block_list.text: Yeah, Sweep! Hehe, that's the spirit!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Hold on a sec... Do you see what I
see in
that store window?!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: I FOUND IT! It's a white snaaake!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: With its geometric patterns and eyes like glass marbles, the snake looks like something an artist would make... Oh wait, it is a work of art.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Not real?! No way... It can't be...
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Waaaah! I'm so sorry, Sweep! I thought we finally had it! Sob!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
...It's fine, we'll go with this snake. It'll
be less
effective, but a doll can work as
a substitute—at
least, that's what my
grimoire says.
text_block_list.name: Свип Тошо

text_block_list.text:
Yep, this'll do! I'm gonna be a
full-fledged witch,
so I'll prove that I can
pull this ritual off, real
snake or no!
text_block_list.name: Свип Тошо

text_block_list.text:
Sweep! Ohhhh, Sweeeeep! You're gonna
make
such an amazing witch!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
We successfully purchase—er, "capture"
the white
snake, bringing a joyful end to
our ordeal.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
